audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreement: full phases[0,1,4,5,6].side all read 'Skill' while content win[0]/[1] read 'Karma' and win[4]/[5]/[6] read 'Thresh'.
audit.why: Karma's Mantra-empowered ranged Q roots and pokes past Thresh's Hook range early; Thresh takes over from level 6 on since Karma has no ult power spike (Mantra is always available) while Thresh's Box, engage burst and pick conversion keep scaling — exactly what content.whys[0,1,4,5,6] already state.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0,1].side to 'Karma' and phases[4,5,6].side to 'Thresh' (matching win[]), rewrote each .why to state the reason, and adjusted ratings.

audit.why: Karma-favored 1-2 on poke range, even 3-5 on the coinflip, Thresh-favored 6 onward once his kit outscales her flat Mantra power.
Level 6 is the swing (no Karma ult spike vs Thresh's Box), first item lets Thresh's burst beat her RE shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Focused Resolve as matchup-defining but carried no cooldown number; report[8].t and report[9].t misgender Karma as 'his/him'.
audit.why: Focused Resolve (W) is a flat 12s cooldown at all ranks. Karma is she/her per champ-gender.js.
audit.corrected: Added the 12s cooldown; fixed both pronouns.
